observations.document_notes: CBO cost estimate for H.R. 8845 (FY2027 House CJS bill). Cited by 22 CJS observations, all outside Title III (Titles I, II and V: DOJ, USPTO, NOAA transfers, rescissions and offsetting collections); each was hand-drafted and verified by the owner against an internal document (human-verified). cbo.gov refuses automated downloads, so no stored file. Interim source: when the rest of CJS is ingested, re-source these figures to the FY2027 House committee report (H.Rpt. 119-652) or the bill, and retire this citation. Re-sourced 2026-10-11: 18 of the 22 figures now cite H.Rept. 119-652's comparative statement (pp. 159-172); 4 stay here because the report's tables don't print them: the FY27 CHIMP rescission and its pop-up (Crime Victims Fund) and the zero direct appropriations of the DOJ Working Capital Fund and the OJP rescission account. The CHIMP rescission (-2,670,000,000) and pop-up (0) are CBO estimates: H.R. 8845 sec. 510 states only the $1,950,000,000 obligation limit, and CBO scores the rescission and pop-up from it.
observations.source_table_or_section: Title VII, FY27 CHIMP
